title: I_∞(δ) is the q-independent stratified census ∑_j 2^{r-2j}C(2^{μ-1},r-2j); δ*=I_∞^{-1}(n) is a single cyclotomic function — but ONLY above the resultant threshold (prize is below it)
evidence: Exact-integer probes (prize regime: dyadic μ_n, n=2^μ a PROPER subgroup, p≡1 mod n prime, p~n^β). (1) IDENTITY CONFIRMED: scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C018_census_envelope.py computes census_p = #{distinct r-subset subgroup-sums in F_p} and the q-independent stratified formula I_∞(μ,r)=∑_{j feas}2^{r-2j}C(2^{μ-1},r-2j). For μ=3 (n=8) and μ=4 (n=16), every prize-scale prime (p~n^4=65536 and p~n^5=1.05e6) gives census_p EXACTLY = I_∞ (e.g. μ=4,r=4: I_∞=1233 = census at p=60017,60161,1000033,1000081, and at an above-threshold p=2^32+81). This matches the in-tree axiom-clean Lean theorem census_card_eq_stratified (KKH26CensusExact.lean), whose threshold hypothesis is exactly (2^μ)^{2^{μ-1}}<p. (2) THE CAVEAT'S SIGN IS WRONG: probe_C018_onset.py shows every below-onset deviation is census_p < I_∞ (a DEFICIT/merge), never a surplus. So the connection's ‘extra mod-p surplus collisions BELOW threshold’ is backwards: small p MERGES distinct char-0 sums (census shrinks), it does not add collisions. (3) THE THRESHOLD IS ASTRONOMICALLY PESSIMISTIC: the TRUE onset of census==I_∞ is governed not by the resultant threshold n^{n/2} but by the largest prime (≡1 mod n) dividing a difference-norm N(λ_S−λ_T). probe_C018_normspectrum.py: μ=3 onset p=17=n^1.36, μ=4 onset p=4049=n^2.996 (matches DISPROOF_LOG O142 max-norm 4097=2^12+1), i.e. ~n^3 — the resultant threshold is 2.4e2x (μ=3) to 1.06e6x (μ=4) too large. At small μ the prize p~n^{4-5} therefore sits ABOVE the onset and census IS q-independent in-prize.
reduced_to: The connection survives ONLY as a sharpened conditional. probe_C018_maxnorm_growth.py shows the difference-norm scale is NOT polynomial: max|N(λ_S−λ_T)| at r=2 is n^2,n^3,n^{4.8} for μ=3,4,5 (in base 2: 2^6,2^12,2^24 — doubling exponent, i.e. ~(const)^{φ(n)=n/2}, super-polynomial). The census-onset is bounded by the LARGEST PRIME FACTOR (≡1 mod n) of these growing norms. At μ=3,4,5 that factor happens to land at ~n^3 (norms factor into small primes), making in-prize q-independence look established; but there is no guarantee it stays below p~n^{4-5} as μ→30. SHARP OPEN STATEMENT: ‘For the prize μ~30, is the largest prime factor ≡1 mod n of any subset-sum difference-norm N(λ_S−λ_T) (λ over r-subsets of μ_n, r=Θ(δn)) below p~n^{4-5}?’ — a clean cyclotomic norm-spectrum (largest-prime-factor) question, strictly cleaner than the original resultant-threshold caveat and decoupled from BGK sup-norms. Even if YES, δ*=I_∞^{-1}(n) is only the KKH26-construction-class CEILING (kkh26_mcaDeltaStar_le, an UPPER bound on the prize δ*), not the prize δ* itself.
wall: W-LamLeung (cyclotomic norm growth / O141 norm-spectrum). The reduced statement is exactly the largest-prime-factor-of-N(λ_S−λ_T) growth crux that gates O134/O141/O142; it does NOT weld to BGK sup-norm cancellation (it is a count/norm-divisibility question, off the Paley eigenvalue wall), but the underlying norm-growth is the W-LamLeung wall the connection itself named.
honest_note: Not a closure. What is PROVEN (and I confirmed by exact probe): the q-independent census identity I_∞ and census_card_eq_stratified are genuinely correct, and contrary to the connection's caveat the unconstrained census reaches I_∞ well below the prize at every tested small μ (onset ~n^3 ≪ n^4). What is OPEN/uncertain and keeps this from closing: (a) the difference-norm scale grows super-polynomially (~(const)^{n/2}), so in-prize q-independence at μ~30 is NOT established — it is conditional on the largest-prime-factor of those norms staying sub-n^5, which I could not verify and which is the W-LamLeung crux; (b) even granting it, I_∞^{-1}(n) is the KKH26 family ceiling, an upper bound on δ*, not the prize δ* (the true δ* is the all-witness/BGK object). The connection's main scientific value is REFRAMING + a CORRECTION: it correctly localizes the census-side difficulty to a finite norm-divisibility question, but its caveat had the sign (surplus vs deficit) and the scale (resultant-threshold vs ~n^3 realized onset) both wrong — both corrected here. Recommend a DISPROOF_LOG note recording the sign correction (deficit not surplus) and the realized-onset~n^3 vs resultant-threshold n^{n/2} gap. Lean was not re-run (the in-tree census_card_eq_stratified already carries its own axiom audit; the load-bearing new work is the probe trio).
